a_third_round_was_refused.reading: correct behaviour, not a failure: a review paused for a human cannot open a new round until that human has acted. The state machine refused it and the message was dead-lettered with an audit event. A later re-run of the harness therefore recorded prior_commitments=0 for THAT attempt and overwrote this artefact with a FAIL; the figures here are read back from Firestore and describe the round-2 resume that did happen.

execution: Cloud Run dispatcher via Eventarc push; drafting on Agent Runtime engines

human_in_the_loop.resolved_via: POST /rounds/{round}/answers/{question}/approval on the deployed control plane

resumed_with_context.source: Memory Bank on the fleet orchestrator engine, migrated this session
resumed_with_context.why_it_matters: open_follow_up reads commitments before any round-2 question is drafted and raises ContextUnavailable rather than proceeding with an empty list -- an empty list is indistinguishable from "this customer was promised nothing" and would silently disable the consistency check for the whole round

round_one.note: the seed never persisted round-1 ANSWERS to Firestore; the round-1 COMMITMENTS are what survived and what round 2 reads, so "round 1 untouched" is not a meaningful check here and is not claimed
